text:
TOOLING BURST FL-5 — fire lane round 5: erupt from the staff tip · impact anywhere · the ending with a small decal, tighter embers, smoke (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; Matt R-C5-122 on cliffside_v40; conductor R-C5-123). task_id "FL-5".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4p, FL-1a (release sockets), FL-2c (capsule), FL-4a, FL-4b, FL-4c and the new row "FL-5 — erupt from the tip · impact anywhere · decal + tighter embers + smoke" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (G1 painted projectile: release socket resolution, head/sheet binding, FL-4a core/trail; range_expiry fizzle path; burst_v2 pieces phase + ember_ending), export/effect_kit.py, export/props_layer.py (the crack_embers recipe), runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json + runs/C-3/cells_v7/cast_*/ (release frames), runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json (+ _A), fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json, runs/C-5/cliffside_v40/ (staged, READ ONLY), runs/C-5/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd and probe_cast_dir.gd, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART A — IMPACT ANYWHERE (bug, Matt): "the impact only works when the bolt hits a dummy; otherwise it is a bolt without an impact." The FL-1a range fizzle is REVERSED for the fire bolt: `range_expiry: "burst"` — at range the bolt lands on the ground and plays the FULL impact (burst + ember ending, decal at the landing point, no victim tint/label/hit-stop since nothing was struck). Fizzle stays available as an option (ice keeps burst-at-range as before). Trace clause: an east cast from (3760,640) at a spot with no target on the line (use FACE=move_up, north) → contact-less expire at range followed by the impact burst at the range point (pieces spawned, ember births); a cast at the shield → the same impact ON the shield with hit response.
PART B — ERUPT FROM THE STAFF TIP (Matt: "emanate specifically from the tip of the staff, not conjured from behind or beside the character; don't show the ball until it's about to land; erupt from the staff, expand into the ball, then impact"). (B1) SOCKET AUDIT: for each of the 8 cast cells render the release frame (cells_v7/cast_<dir>/ frame release_index) with the current release socket marked (a 6-px cross) into runs/C-5/t3/FL-5/socket_audit/<dir>.png and a contact sheet; where the marked point is NOT the staff's far tip (the end away from the hands, along the facing), re-derive it from the frame's alpha (the staff is the longest thin dark structure; its endpoint farthest along the facing vector) and write the corrected socket into sockets_v2.json `cells.cast_<dir>.sockets[release_index]` with the before/after table. (B2) ERUPTION: new travel fields `travel.eruption {frames 8, scale_from 0.25, sheet_delay_frames 3}`: at release the head spawns at the socket at 0.25 scale with the additive core at full alpha (a bright point at the tip), scales to 1.0 over 8 frames with an ease-out while already moving; the flame sheet appears from frame 3, growing from the head backwards; the cast muzzle puff (FL-2) fires at the tip on frame 0. The head's painted body is not shown at full size until ≥ 8 frames (≈ 0.13 s; at 1510 px/s that is ~200 px out — the ball is visible for the last ~0.2 s of a 0.34 s flight: "until it's about to land"). (B3) SIZE: head extent 1.2 → 1.0 BH, sheet 2.2 → 1.9 BH (kit scales; primitives byte-identical). Trace clause: head drawn extent per frame 0–12 (ramp), sheet visible from frame 3, socket = the audited tip for all 8 directions (release position within 0.1 BH of the marked tip).
PART C — THE ENDING (Matt: "still needs some of the painted/decal section with a matching white-hot glow; embers too large and too spread out; a tiny bit of smoky fog should shroud the embers and the white-hot glow as a small central decal subsides"). (C1) SMALL CENTRAL DECAL: after the spent frame, keep the WHITE CORE PIECE ONLY as a painted residue at the burst centre, scaled to 0.6 BH, α 1 → 0 over 0.5 s with outside-in erosion (`pieces.core_residue {scale_bh .6, seconds .5}`), under the matching white-hot additive glow (core_radius_bh .45 → .5, core_s .6 — same clock, same centre). (C2) EMBERS TIGHTER + SMALLER: ember_ending amount 48 → 36, rect_bh [1.8,.9] → [1.0,.5], scale [.15,.33] → [.08,.18], spread 28° → 18°, speed [30,90] → [25,70], life [1.0,1.6] → [.9,1.4]. (C3) SMOKE: `pieces.smoke {sheet "noise", radius_bh .8, alpha .28, rise_px_s 22, seconds .9, tint [.35,.3,.28]}` — a soft MIX-blend grey-warm noise sheet (the shared whole-canvas noise, two octaves) centred on the burst, born at the spent frame, drifting up 22 px/s, α .28 fading to 0 over .9 s, drawn UNDER the embers and glow (z below), compat-safe (no screen texture). Trace clause: core residue visible ages 26–56 with decreasing alpha; ember births 36 within the rect; smoke node alpha samples at 26/40/56/80; total effect life ≤ 1.9 s.
PART E — LOUDER INTERLEAVES (Matt R-C5-124: "louder, bigger tongues and more of them"): fire_burst_e0p_v3 interleave count [3,5] → [5,7] (fill every gap wider than 25°, largest first), tongue scale [0.8,1.15] → [1.2,1.6], stretch 1.15 → 1.3, rooted 0.1 BH further out (root_radius × 1.1) so they read outside the core; keep the per-cast seeding and the parity sampler in step (update the Python sampler + its 20-seed test to the new ranges). Trace clause: for 5 seeds, tongue count in [5,7], max angular gap after placement ≤ 40°, mean tongue drawn extent ≥ 0.9 BH; selections still differ across seeds and reproduce per seed.

PART D — byte locks re-opened (FL-1b rule); the catalogue lock stays red (E3-r1) — name it.

Apply to runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (provenance "R-C5-122 FL-5"), fire_bolt_e1_A/B kit.json, fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json; primitives byte-identical; sockets_v2.json named entries only.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-5/acceptance.json): Part A traces (north + shield); Part B socket audit sheet + before/after + eruption ramp; Part C trace clauses; Part E interleave clauses; 15 kits byte-identical; full 18-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): eruption ramp; range burst; socket-tip clause; ending fields; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except the three fire kits' kit.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-5/, the spec's named fields and sockets_v2.json named entries; fixtures/ only for Part D. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-5/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-5"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
